summary: Texted garage-apartment rental: power shutoff for late rent, 7-day landlord termination notice.

findings.quote: if rent isn't paid by the 10th the power to the apartment gets shut off until you're caught up.
i can end it with 7 days' notice.

findings.note: No notice address for the landlord; the property address might be read as his.

nearMisses.quote: i'll text you at least a day ahead before coming in to fix anything, and i'll only come between 9 am and 7 pm.
no deposit needed since you're a friend of the family.
